text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, happy birthday. Looking forward... to 
working with you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Congratulatory words show a commendable 
spirit. —Now, what follows?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Words of celebration for me. Surely what 
you said just now isn't enough, is it?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Even if you say that... um... Well...—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm gonna keep pushing forward. This 
year, next year, straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No matter how high the wall is, I'll 
definitely take on the challenge. That's 
why—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep battling you with 
everything I've got, sir!! And one day, 
without fail... I'll show you I can win!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However, where are your words of 
celebration? Did I not say they were 
insufficient? Ah, and I have not received 
your gift yet either, have I?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I do have a present, but...! 
Seriously... you really are something 
else...
